title: Orchestrating LLM Agents for Scientific Research: A Pilot Study of Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Generation and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2602.18891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming scientific work, yet empirical evidence on how these systems reshape research activities remains limited. We report a mixed-methods pilot evaluation of an AI-orchestrated research workflow in which a human researcher coordinated multiple LLM-based agents to perform data extraction, corpus construction, artifact generation, and artifact evaluation. translated_title: 编排大语言模型智能体用于科学研究：多项选择题（MCQ）生成与评估的试点研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步正在迅速改变科学工作，但关于这些系统如何重塑研究活动的实证证据仍然有限。我们报告了一项针对AI编排研究工作流程的混合方法试点评估，在该流程中，一名人类研究者协调多个基于LLM的智能体来执行数据提取、语料库构建、产物生成和产物评估。以多项选择题（MCQ）的生成与评估作为测试平台，我们收集了1,071道SAT数学多项选择题，并利用LLM智能体从PDF中提取题目、检索开放教科书并将其转换为结构化表示、将每道MCQ与相关教科书内容对齐、在指定的难度和认知水平下生成新的MCQ，并使用包含24项标准的质量框架对原始MCQ和生成的MCQ进行评估。在所有评估中，MCQ的平均质量都很高。然而，在标准层面的……
tldr: 本研究以SAT数学多项选择题的生成与评估为测试平台，验证了由人类研究者协调多个LLM智能体执行数据提取、语料构建、题目生成与质量评估的AI编排科研工作流程能够产出高质量的科研成果。
en_tdlr: This pilot study demonstrates that an AI-orchestrated research workflow, in which a human researcher coordinates multiple LLM agents to perform data extraction, corpus construction, artifact generation, and evaluation, can produce high-quality MCQs, as tested on 1,071 SAT Math questions under a 24-criterion quality framework.
